sections.title: FAQs
sections.content: What is an LOS System? A Loan Origination System (LOS) is a digital system that automates elements of the loan application process from start to finish. A LOS can assist lenders to perform a variety of tasks in a timely manner, including credit checks, document requests and storage, underwriting, and decisioning, while ensuring regulation compliance and enhancing borrower experience. What are some advantages of using a loan origination system for lenders? A LOS loan origination system allows a lender to streamline aspects of their application process, maximize efficiencies through the automation of monotonous tasks in the mortgage process more accurately. It also measures data through integrated systems, improves regulatory compliance, increases visibility among teams in real time (underwriting, sales), and increases the speed and ease with which the lender serves the borrower. How do I find the best loan origination system? When identifying the best loan origination systems , you need to consider the requirements of your business and identify features you would find beneficial such as the ability to automate workflows, high-quality integrations with companies such as credit bureaus and CRMs, quality compliance technology, scalability, and ease of use. You will also want to research vendor review data, general practices for maintaining security standards, and specifications to ongoing support to vendors post-implementation. Can you customize an LOS System? Yes, customization is available in most lending systems . The lender can customize workflows, roles and permissions, documents, and rules to comply with internal processes and regulatory requirements. Hence, this makes the system work effectively for business objectives as well as their customers.! How much does it cost to implement an LOS System? Typical implementations for a loan origination system range anywhere from $20k to $150k depending on the provider, level of customization, the number of users, and integrations. Cloud based systems offer subscription alternatives and may range from $500 to $2500 per month. How long does it take to implement a loan origination system? It can take from 4 weeks to 6 months to implement a loan origination system, depending on the complexity of the system, level of customization, and integrations required. Simpler cloud-based systems will deploy more quickly while a fully customized enterprise system will take longer to roll out and implement effectively.
